title: No quantum comes out larger than one went in
spoken: h times the emitted frequency is at most h times the absorbed frequency.
explanation: If each emitted quantum is made from one absorbed quantum, it cannot carry more energy than that quantum brought, so the emitted light is no higher in frequency. This is Stokes's rule, read as an energy budget.
assumptions: Each emitted quantum is made from a single absorbed quantum.
These are modern teaching equations in SI notation, not a transcription of the printed paper.

notes.title: Planck's constant
notes.explanation: Turns the emitted frequency into the emitted quantum's energy.

notes.title: Frequency of the emitted light
notes.explanation: What the fluorescent body gives out.

notes.title: Planck's constant
notes.explanation: The same constant, on the absorbed side.

notes.title: At most, not equal
notes.explanation: Some energy can stay in the body, so the emitted quantum may be smaller. The bound holds only if each emitted quantum comes from one absorbed quantum; the paper says where that assumption may fail.
